If the new story doesn't reach answers, competitors' and reviewers' framing wins the shortlist.
seo_need.why_not_yet: agency_run: strong historical SEO run by brand/content team with content partners and an AEO contractor; no dedicated owner, which the new role fixes.

reply_odds.why: High need and active hiring for exactly this work (growing, can pay: lead role, director band ~$200k), but the hiring manager's name couldn't be verified and marketing leadership is in flux; applying through the Ashby post plus a note to the VP Marketing / Director Demand Gen is the route. Role is US-hiring only, so an engagement/audit angle may land better than the role itself.
